sloka: सौमित्रे हर काष्ठानि निर्मथिष्यामि पावकम् ।गृध्र राजम् दिधक्षामि मत् कृते निधनम् गतम् ॥३-६८-२७॥
transliteration: saumitre hara kāṣṭhāni nirmathiṣyāmi pāvakam ।gṛdhra rājam didhakṣāmi mat kṛte nidhanam gatam ॥3-68-27॥

translations.english: O Saumitri fetch firewood. I shall generate fire by rubbing them and cremate the king of the birds who has laid down his life for my sake.
